summary: Standard Lithium filed a Form 6-K on 2026-10-13 attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Ralph Alexander as an independent member of its Board of Directors, effective immediately. The appointment is a routine board addition, not a forced or abrupt departure, and no resignation, merger, tender, or financing terms are disclosed. Chairman Bob Cross and CEO David Park commented on Alexander's energy-sector experience. No financial terms, advisor, or strategic transaction were stated, so this is treated as an ordinary governance disclosure with no special-situation angle to watch.
